query.description: Natural-language functional query to resolve into GO and/or InterPro identifiers.
examples: alpha kinase activity and beta transporter domain

target_names.description: Optional explicit protein, enzyme, family, or domain names to prioritize during resolution.

semantic_intents.description: Optional bounded semantic facets to resolve independently. Each item may include intent_id, label, query, and required; unresolved required facets are reported without poisoning resolved facets.

preferred_namespaces.description: Identifier namespaces to search, ordered by preference when both GO and InterPro are acceptable.

aspect.description: Optional GO aspect hint, such as molecular_function, biological_process, cellular_component, or null.

limit_per_target.description: Maximum resolver candidates to keep for each target name or inferred search target.

timeout_s.description: Maximum wall-clock time in seconds for remote resolver requests.
